history_support: Vapour area (m²) = native vapour volume / 0.01 m numerical depth; per-row sum of native water and vapour integrals. No point averaging or pixel area. Vapour maximum, absolute-pressure minimum (Pa) and speed maximum (m/s) are sampled native z=0 plane point extrema, not whole-volume cell extrema. Alpha bound tolerance 1e-7; raw values retained without clipping. All output times retained; no resampling, causal-lag or steady-state inference.
limitations: Strict 2D WALE flow only; not acoustics or physical validation.
